title: Food Bank
description: A single food bank or food pantry listing. One file per organization in data/foodbanks/, named {state}-{city}-{slug}.json matching the id field.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case: {state}-{city}-{name-slug}, e.g. tx-dallas-crossroads-community-services. Must match the filename (without .json).

hours.description: Regular weekly hours when food is distributed. Leave empty and use hoursNotes for irregular schedules.

hoursNotes.description: Free text for schedules the hours array cannot express, e.g. '2nd and 4th Saturday of each month'.

requirements.description: Plain-language description of anything a visitor needs (ID, proof of address, appointment). Empty or absent means walk-ins welcome.

serviceAreaRestricted.description: True if only residents of certain ZIP codes / cities are served.

affiliation.description: Informational only (e.g. a church or denomination). Listings must serve everyone regardless of belief; religious participation may never be a condition of receiving food.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the hours are in, e.g. America/Chicago. Defaults to America/Chicago (all current listings are in Texas); required in spirit for entries outside Central Time.

referralHub.description: True for regional distribution organizations (e.g. Feeding America food banks) that are not walk-up pantries themselves — shown with a distinct badge so visitors aren't sent to a warehouse.

lastVerified.description: Date the details were last checked against the organization's own site, YYYY-MM-DD.

sourceUrl.description: Where the details were verified — the page that actually carries the facts, not just the org homepage.
